I had the same problem as many of you; The Brick-Force Client was still not updated although I downloaded the new setup from the website. Then, when I tried to start it sometimes, it always closed immediately. Well, this is what I did.

First of all, uninstall Brick-Force. For Windows, go to the Control Panel, to Uninstall a Program, and just uninstall Brick-Force.

NOW, if you don't do this step correctly, there's no point of even trying to get Brick-Force to work!!!
So now, go on your hard drive (I just go on "My Computer" and go on my hard disk drive, which is usually C:\), find the BrickForce folder, and delete it. **NOTE: Just to be sure, search for all BRick-Force files on your hard drive and delete all of them.**

What you do now is that you go to the Brick-Force website, and download the client. (I don't know why, but the European Client worked for me. As far as I know, it makes no difference what client you download as long as you choose the right server during installation.)

Install Brick-Force again, but when the installation is finished. When it asks to run Brick-Force, uncheck it. Click finish.

Now, for the final steps. Go on your desktop. Find the Brick-Force shortcut, right click it, and choose "Run as administrator". Brick Force should start, then download all the patches (This will take a few minutes, don't be deceived if it freezes for a while.) After that is done, you should be able to click start and Brick Force should load. On the top left corner it should have version 1.6 release 62.

Happy easter everyone!

Dear Community,
Every now and then, we see problems posted here in the forum which can only be solved by our Technical Support as only those colleagues have the necessary means to do so.

This mainly concerns all threads that are related to purchases, for example the purchase of Tokens, Premium Accounts or items. Please address all questions concerning your account to our Support.

The same applies for technical difficulties, for example if you need help with the installation or for crashes or if you have general technical questions about the client or browser version.

Please note that our support will answer you in any case. However, depending on the problem described in the ticket, this might take some time, for example when you send out your requests in the evenings or on weekends.

You can contact support here: http://support.infernum.com/

Many questions have been previously answered which is why the next best solution to your problem might be searching the Forums or taking a look into our Knowledgebase.

Some answers to popular questions have been listed for you in the following.

Connection lost
Please take a look at our Website or in the Launcher and check if there is a server maintenance. Scheduled maintenances are usually announced there on time.
If you cannot find any information on server maintenances, please try clicking on “Server List” (in-game) instead of “Play” and choose a different channel. This can also help.

Tokens were not delivered after I bought them
Before you turn to our support, please note that the delivery of Tokens might take a few minutes. Please also remember that you have to restart the game after buying Tokens in order for the correct amount to be displayed.
If your Token purchase coincidentally clashes with a server maintenance, don’t worry about them getting lost. As soon as the maintenance works are finished, your Tokens will be delivered.
Especially when it comes to “Earn Tokens”, Token delivery can take some time. Unfortunately, in this case, duration cannot be controlled or influenced by us.

Old Brick-Force version
If you receive this error message, Brick-Force needs an update. In order to initiate this process, please start the game by double-clicking on the file BfLauncher.exe which you will find in your Brick-Force folder. If this does not work, please contact our support at http://support.infernum.com/.

I didn’t receive my bonus Tokens during a promotion
Please note that during promotions, all bonus Tokens are already included in the amount listed in the purchase overview. Thus, if the Token amount listed there is the amount you received, you got all Tokens you paid for.

Forgot Password
If you have forgotten your password, you can request a new one here: https://www.brick-force.com/en/password-request
